page: Google Cloud Platform n4-highmem-48 is a memory-optimized server instance powered by an Intel x86_64 processor. It features 48 dedicated virtual CPUs, derived from 24 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 384 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per core. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, and comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The Intel processor includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for tile and INT8 operations, alongside cryptographic accelerations like AES and SHA_NI. In benchmark testing, the instance demonstrates strong multi-core capabilities, scoring in the top 25% for Passmark CPU, Passmark CPU physics, and Geekbench multi-core tests. It also shows strong performance in ray tracing and image processing workloads. Single-core performance and software compilation benchmarks fall within the average range.

Memory performance is a key highlight, with large-block uncached read and write bandwidths reaching 254.09 GB/sec and 113.1 GB/sec respectively, both placing in the top 25%. This high memory throughput supports demanding database operations, which also scored in the top tier of Passmark benchmarks. Static web serving throughput is strong at 67.89 GB/sec. For artificial intelligence workloads, the instance achieves strong prompt processing speeds of 179.15 tokens/sec on medium-sized 7B LLM models, though text generation and larger model inference remain average. This profile makes the instance highly suitable for memory-intensive databases, large-scale data processing, and enterprise web serving.
description: Google Cloud Platform n4-highmem-48 is an x86_64 memory-optimized server configured with 48 dedicated vCPUs (24 physical cores) and 384 GB of RAM, yielding 8 GB of memory per core. Powered by an Intel processor, it features an L3 cache of 260 MB and supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel AMX. The instance lacks bundled local storage and GPUs. Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core CPU performance, high-speed large-block memory bandwidth, and excellent database operation throughput, placing it in the top 25% of tested systems. It also delivers strong performance in static web serving and medium-model LLM prompt processing. This server is optimized for memory-intensive workloads, including enterprise databases, data analytics, and memory-heavy web applications where high memory capacity and robust multi-threaded processing are required.
